description: This file defines a mock class 'WarehouseMock' implementing 'IWarehouse' interface for unit testing, along with a related notification mock. It is intended for testing warehouse-related functionalities in the application.

classes.name: WarehouseMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IWarehouse interface for testing warehouse operations.

classes.name: WarehouseNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IWarehouse::INotification interface for testing warehouse notification callbacks.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registration of a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks unregistration of a notification callback.

methods.name: ExecuteHardwareTest
methods.description: Mocks execution of a hardware test.

methods.name: GetHardwareTestResults
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of hardware test results.

methods.name: IsClean
methods.description: Mocks checking if the warehouse is clean based on age.

methods.name: LightReset
methods.description: Mocks a light reset of the warehouse.

methods.name: ResetDevice
methods.description: Mocks resetting the device with optional reboot.

methods.name: ResetDone
methods.description: Mocks notification callback indicating reset completion.
